rationale: The workflow runs `Pkg.add(PackageSpec(name="JuliaFormatter", version="0.14.4"))` on every invocation, repeatedly fetching and installing the JuliaFormatter dependency. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by observational evidence with reported benefit (modest VM time reduction) and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and no equivalent cache already exists. Adding an `actions/cache` step for the Julia depot avoids repeated dependency downloads while preserving the format check coverage and all original steps. No matrix exists, so fail-fast does not apply; no stale-run cancellation is needed at the workflow level. The change is minimal and does not alter test coverage, permissions, or introduce privileged actions, secrets, or deployment operations.
